22A.21 An army is divided into three divisions to divert the attention of the enemy and to conceal the attack.
22B.1 Males 20 years old and up are to be mustered and enrolled for military service.
22B.4 Military chain of authority is to be established --Officers over thousands, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens.
